description: MCP tools for the headless BPMN 2.0 XML converter (plan "BPMN 2.0 XML converter", phase 5): modeling_import_bpmn imports a BPMN document into modeling models with the loss report (optionally persisted through the document provider) and modeling_export_bpmn exports a stored model back to BPMN 2.0 XML. Both directions run the built-in Camunda/Signavio/Bizagi tool dialect plugins, so tool metadata survives the round trip.
